en.headline: Samsung ends large appliance sales in Hong Kong, shifts focus to TVs and mobiles
en.dek: The company said it is concentrating resources on televisions, displays and mobile devices while maintaining after-sales support for products already sold.
body: Samsung Electronics has stopped selling large home appliances including refrigerators, washing machines, air-conditioners and vacuum cleaners through its Hong Kong website, with those categories listed as sold out.

In a statement, Samsung Hong Kong said it continues to assess and adjust its product portfolio to match changing market conditions and consumer preferences. As part of the strategic adjustment, it is focusing resources on televisions, displays, audio products, commercial screens and mobile communication devices.

The company said after-sales service, warranties and repair support for products already sold will continue. Korean media reports earlier indicated the Hong Kong unit had begun preparing the withdrawal one to two months ago, following a May decision to halt appliance sales on the mainland.

Local retailers and website checks confirmed the large-appliance listings were unavailable for purchase while mobile phones and televisions remained on sale. Customer-service staff had previously described the situation as temporary stock shortages.

zh.headline: 三星停售香港大型家電 資源轉向電視及流動裝置
zh.dek: 三星香港表示正將資源集中於電視、顯示器及流動通訊裝置，並維持已售產品的售後及維修服務。
body: 三星電子香港網站已停止銷售包括雪櫃、洗衣機、冷氣機及吸塵機在內的大型家用電器，相關產品顯示售罄。
三星香港回應指，公司一直持續評估並調整產品組合，以切合不斷變化的市場環境及消費者喜好。作為策略調整的一部分，現正將資源集中於發展電視、顯示器、音響產品、商用顯示器及流動通訊裝置。
公司表示將維持已售產品的售後服務、保養及維修支援。韓媒早前報道，三星香港子公司約一至兩個月前已開始為撤出作準備，此舉延續今年五月停止在中國內地銷售家電的決定。
本地零售商及網站查核確認大型家電無法購買，而手機及電視仍可正常選購。客服人員早前曾形容情況為暫時缺貨。
